Services

Engagements begin with the business problem.

HS108 services translate diagnosis into the right design intervention. Deliverables matter, but only after the problem is understood.

Service Paths

Choose by outcome, not by deliverable.

Each path explains the problem, the likely diagnosis, and what changes when the system works.

01

CX & Identity

Improve Positioning

The business is valuable, but the market cannot quickly understand why it should care.

Value is often present before it is legible. The work is to make difference, trust, and fit easier to understand.

See How The System Works 02

WebCanvas

Reduce Purchase Friction

Customers show interest, but uncertainty interrupts the path to enquiry, purchase, or adoption.

Most digital friction is an information problem before it is an interface problem.

See How The System Works 03

CMF Nexus

Build Market Confidence

A product needs to justify trust, quality, and purchase intent before people experience it physically.

Material, form, finish, and product storytelling must support the same market decision.

See How The System Works 04

Lumina Raw

Clarify Visual Evidence

The business needs proof, but its images and motion do not explain the value clearly enough.

Visual content should carry evidence, not fill space or chase attention.
